novelty_flags.label: related_work and literature_map treatment of deChaisemartinEtAl2025ContinuousStayers
novelty_flags.one_line: The core describes this paper as an exact-stayer result only, but its no-stayer section gives a conditional quasi-stayer identification theorem; present it as the closest point-identification comparator and state precisely that the proposed sharp set treats failure of its conditional support condition.
